pr.title: T-2376/T-2386: Green Tree connecting range and Wolf Point picture credit
pr.body:
Green Tree Tavern gains the low connector and turned farther gabled range shown by its historical evidence, replacing the previous rear ell. Its open wagon bay continues to use the existing procedural yard roof/posts. Native occupied-solid consumers preserve the separate building rings and open gaps through compilation, collision, routes, ground, entrances and framing.

Wolf Point Tavern's Images card gains the credited Newberry record for the Blanchard/Davis poster. The source's date disagreement and the older 1867 print's inspection-only disposition remain explicit. The reviewed Wolf work from superseded PR #1657 is preserved by normal merging its immutable head 520884613539cec3ba6874a1c82cd5ee377665a9 into this branch; one changelog entry retains all four visitor-facing items.

Source tickets T-2376 and T-2386 remain partial, open, and unbound to an automatic ticket close. Green Tree's Andreas comparison remains `differs` with one compound open entry for the remaining closed-shoulder/opening/source-reading differences. This PR does not claim either building's whole image gate is finished.

Combined integration head: `ebf7befa1afba05947578a5ee08e0cbc8655d98a`, tree `9408f2014cb52da1d28a687cb42198d3f2b64602`, incorporating public dev `422224622274a7a5071b1177969682ac5170788a` and reviewed Wolf head `520884613539cec3ba6874a1c82cd5ee377665a9`.

Validation:

- All four source parts passed on the exact authored GT head `c1c7d7bcf2e601588ec807af7383d063e248eb15` and Wolf head `ea0aef7c2a5b3a3d6a17613be263bc52a4f1845e`.
- Combined native SourceUse ownership and all 556 non-report outputs/report/manifest agree exactly; nine native freshness checks and pre/post-commit changelog/ID checks pass. All 50 frame MASTER/WEB assets, six protected models, 25 full native recipe documents, version links, and the entire latest Liberty book plus the exact GT appendix are preserved. No local Blender or rebake claim.
- Native combined publication/contract passed. Fresh combined desktop/phone GT default-world/exterior and Wolf seven-picture/full-credit checks passed with625 bound inputs and all5812 published members unchanged; all six actual captures were directly reviewed. Official published Stage3 passed107/0 at both viewports (mobile172.25s,desktop363.67s). Earlier4ccb/520 and c563 GT Images/native-arrival proofs retain their original head scopes.
- Current-head required [source gate](https://github.com/kevinrhaas/chicago/actions/runs/41616933756) and [moving-frames check](https://github.com/kevinrhaas/chicago/actions/runs/41616933656) passed before normal protected merge. One moving-frame attempt had a single25.8ms timing excursion above21ms; one unchanged job retry passed with the same ceilings, and both transcripts are retained.

Durable checkpoints: [GT authored four-part checks](https://github.com/kevinrhaas/chicago-evidence/blob/ba80a92b7749f3986d32b038a1c51acd4c483969/evidence/green-tree-2026-11-03/authored-c1c7d7bc-source4/RECOVERY.md), [GT 4ccb actual UI/native107x2 qualification](https://github.com/kevinrhaas/chicago-evidence/blob/ee169943ca7857789c9ee71855caa57e91ff90e2/evidence/green-tree-2026-11-03/qualified-4ccb-night-street-ui-native3/RECOVERY.md), and [Wolf authored source/checkpoint](https://github.com/kevinrhaas/chicago-evidence/commit/3dbcfdfa5a9a9ce4c74fdfc8c6dfdb1d75515993).

Merged normally under protection as `738f0f81566693980a09f20175a90c5602ec042f`. [Combined pushed-source/native checkpoint](https://github.com/kevinrhaas/chicago-evidence/blob/5ef715f24236fb0db29540baea8e38c38daf5e8b/evidence/green-tree-2026-11-03/combined-ebf7-pushed-source/RECOVERY.md). Both original tickets remain open/partial with no PR binding.
